stories.title: Scaffold TypeScript project with Vitest and Express

criteria.text: package.json exists and the 'name' field equals exactly 'skyscanner-app'
package.json 'scripts' object contains exactly: build='tsc', test='vitest run', start='node dist/server.js', dev='tsx src/server.ts' — and 'main' equals 'dist/server.js'
criteria.evidence: scripts: { build: 'tsc', test: 'vitest run', start: 'node dist/server.js', dev: 'tsx src/server.ts' }; main: 'dist/server.js' — all match exactly

criteria.text: package.json 'devDependencies' includes all of: typescript, tsx, vitest, @types/express, @types/node
package.json contains no dependency whose name includes 'skyscanner', 'rapidapi', or any Skyscanner SDK
criteria.evidence: grep for skyscanner/rapidapi in package.json only matched the description string ('backed by RapidAPI'), not any dependency name; dependencies and devDependencies keys contain no such references

criteria.text: tsconfig.json exists with compilerOptions: strict=true, target='ES2022', module='CommonJS', outDir='dist/'
criteria.evidence: tsconfig.json read; compilerOptions: strict=true, target='ES2022', module='CommonJS', outDir='dist/' — all present and correct

criteria.text: vitest.config.ts exists, imports defineConfig from 'vitest/config', exports a default config object, and sets test.globals to true
criteria.evidence: vitest.config.ts imports { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config', exports default defineConfig({ test: { globals: true, passWithNoTests: true } })

criteria.text: .gitignore exists and contains entries for both 'node_modules' and 'dist'
node_modules/ directory exists (npm install completed successfully)
Running tsc --noEmit exits with code 0 and produces no output
criteria.evidence: tsc --noEmit exited with code 0 and produced no output

criteria.text: Running vitest run exits with code 0 (no test files is an acceptable passing state)
criteria.evidence: vitest run exited with code 0; output: 'No test files found, exiting with code 0'

criteria.text: package.json contains no reference anywhere to 'index.ts' or 'index.js'
criteria.evidence: grep for 'index.ts' and 'index.js' in package.json returned no matches (exit code 1)
